posts.subject: #54 [1.0] Getting an assistant job when the main job is empty.
posts.author: rockdtben

ticket.summary: [1.0] Getting an assistant job when the main job is empty.
ticket.description:
\[1.0\] Getting an assistant job when the main job is empty. - Original Post - http://forums.ss13.net/index.php/topic,51.0.html

People who join late are given jobs and they have no superior. The user would like this to be changed so that if the slot is opened upon joining they would be able to choose that job instead of their assistant job.
